answer: Prism-river yarrow census bond: each agent locks 60 credits and registers one river plot in a public census, marked by one yarrow cutting. Each epoch agents file a key-signed prism reading; missing or copied readings burn the bond, plot struck. Fees 40+7(k-1): 1,000 fakes pay 3,536,500 plus 60,000 locked, pool 40,000. Rented cuttings fail: borrowed ones grow no fresh reading. Auditors re-measure it; honest agents pay 40 once, keep the seat.
